description: This file declares the `Request` class used for handling JSON-RPC request messages over WebSockets. It includes methods for creating requests, retrieving the request ID, and converting requests to string form. It also manages an atomic sequence for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request message for WebSockets communication, capable of being created with specific method names and parameters, and managing unique request IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs a new JSON-RPC request with a specified method name and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the request message to a string.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for requests, using an atomic sequence.
